blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–It took the resolve rarely seen in untested warriors for Art Arbole to end a 14-year wait for a breakthrough title, as he lost his overnight lead early to trail by three before coming up with a fightback that will stand out in PGT lore as one of the bravest ever seen. “Laban lang nang laban (I just fought it out),” Arbole said after gutting out a level-par 70 to rule the P2.5 million ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic by a shot over Jeff Lumbo and a horde of champions he fended off in the stretch with an amazing display of […]...
